slot_scores.name: sequential_machine_order_constraint
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Does every product have to be processed on all three machines in the fixed order Machine 1 → Machine 2 → Machine 3 (i.e., a product cannot start on Machine 2 until it has finished on Machine 1, and cannot start on Machine 3 until it has finished on Machine 2)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether products follow a fixed machine sequence M1→M2→M3, directly covering the hidden slot.

slot_scores.name: minimize_total_processing_cycle
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the goal to minimize the total time (makespan) until all three products have finished on all three machines, with each machine able to process only one product at a time?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether the objective is to minimize makespan, clarifying the ambiguous 'total processing cycle' term.

stopping_behavior.rationale: Both P0 hidden slots were resolved before READY_TO_MODEL; the agent stopped after confirming the objective and machine sequence constraints.

summary: The agent asked targeted questions that resolved both P0 hidden slots—the makespan objective and the fixed M1→M2→M3 machine sequence—before entering READY_TO_MODEL, resulting in a clean and appropriate clarification process.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
